source_register.title: Interpretations & Decisions index

observations.statement: OCC CAS records Ripple National Trust Bank as approved 2025-12-12 and Consummated/Effective 2026-10-26.
limitations: CAS status is an official transaction-status record; it does not by itself prove the bank has commenced all approved operations.

observations.statement: Ripple's 2026-10-26 announcement says the OCC granted final approval. It identifies approved activities as managing segregated RLUSD reserves, acting as collateral trustee for RLUSD holders, and providing fiduciary digital-asset custody services.
limitations: The press release says custody is authorized upon opening and does not establish actual operating volumes or commencement of every service.

observations.statement: OCC's 2025 Ripple decision letter describes a national trust bank limited to trust-company activities. It identifies Standard Custody & Trust Company as RLUSD issuer and describes the proposed bank's work as RLUSD reserve management, collateral trustee services and fiduciary crypto custody. It says the bank will not be an insured depository institution.
limitations: This is the original preliminary conditional decision letter, not a separately retrieved final approval letter.

observations.statement: OCC CAS records First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A. (Circle's proposed trust bank) as approved 2025-12-12 and Consummated/Effective 2026-07-24.
limitations: The CAS status does not establish actual USDC reserve balances held by the bank or operational throughput.

observations.statement: OCC CAS records Coinbase National Trust Company as approved 2026-04-02, with no Consummated/Effective action shown on the retrieved detail page.
limitations: Absence of an effective date in this retrieved record does not prove the entity is inactive; it means effective status was not established from this record.

observations.statement: The OCC Interpretations & Decisions index continues to display Ripple's original preliminary conditional approval entry; the CAS record supplies a later Consummated/Effective date. The two records represent different stages and should not be conflated.
limitations: The index may lag or omit the later consummation record; the CAS detail page is the more current status evidence in this snapshot.

observations.statement: The Ripple trust-bank approval record and decision letter do not identify XRP as an approved reserve asset, collateral asset or required operating asset. The defined purpose is RLUSD reserve management, collateral trusteeship and fiduciary custody.
limitations: No inference is made that Ripple or the bank will never custody or transact in XRP under other permissions or products.

observations.statement: Circle and Ripple have OCC trust-bank transactions recorded as Consummated/Effective, while Coinbase's retrieved CAS record shows Approved but no effective date. This creates a measurable difference in the recorded regulatory-organization stage among the three firms.
limitations: This is a status comparison, not a ranking of overall regulatory quality, financial strength or product adoption.

competing_hypotheses.name: Regulated trust-bank infrastructure is a competitive moat for stablecoin and institutional custody distribution
competing_hypotheses.thesis: Circle and Ripple have moved their OCC trust-bank transactions to Consummated/Effective status; Coinbase has an approved application without an effective date in the retrieved CAS record. This may affect institutional onboarding, reserve custody, and product distribution.
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: Effective status does not prove operating scale, customer balances, revenue or market share.
Coinbase may have later status updates not captured in the retrieved detail page.
The firms' approved scopes and operating models are not identical.

competing_hypotheses.name: Ripple trust-bank approval directly increases XRP demand
competing_hypotheses.thesis: The bank's regulatory approval could be interpreted as a catalyst for XRP utility.
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: The defined bank scope is centered on RLUSD reserves, collateral trusteeship and digital-asset custody.
The OCC decision letter and Ripple release do not identify XRP as a required bank reserve or collateral asset.
No XRP-specific bank balances, collateral usage, payment flows or purchases are disclosed.

competing_hypotheses.name: Circle and Ripple are converging on parallel regulated stablecoin/custody models while Coinbase positions as a distribution and exchange platform
competing_hypotheses.thesis: Circle's and Ripple's effective trust-bank records, Coinbase's separate approved trust-bank application, Coinbase's stablecoin distribution role and each issuer's product integrations suggest overlapping but distinct strategies.
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: No evidence here establishes a direct Ripple-Circle corporate agreement or coordinated strategy.
No effective date for Coinbase was found in its CAS detail page.
Actual institutional usage and economics remain unquantified.

key_unknowns: Whether Ripple National Trust Bank has commenced operations and the date of its first live reserve-management/custody activity.
Whether the final OCC approval conditions differ materially from the 2025 preliminary conditional decision letter.
Actual assets under custody and RLUSD reserve assets administered by Ripple National Trust Bank versus BNY and Standard Custody & Trust Company.
Whether Circle's First National Digital Currency Bank has begun live operations and what USDC reserve/custody functions it performs.
Whether Coinbase National Trust Company has since received a Consummated/Effective date or begun operations.
Any XRP-specific holdings, custody, collateral, bridge usage or payment flow attributable to the trust-bank entities.
next_actions: Monitor OCC CAS status and institution lists for subsequent operational updates.
Obtain the final OCC approval letter and compare its conditions with the 2025 preliminary decision.
Track Circle Q3 2026 results on 2026-11-04 at 08:00 ET for reserve income, distribution economics and any First National Digital Currency Bank update.
Compare live product disclosures for RLUSD, USDC, Coinbase custody and derivatives collateral; separate eligibility from utilization.
Do not convert trust-bank regulatory approval into an XRP price or demand prediction without observable XRP-specific flows.
